arguments.command: cd /work && rm -f example.idx && ./submit/planb64 build examples/fib.txt example.idx; echo "build rc=$?"; cmp example.idx examples/expected.idx && echo "IDX MATCH"; ./submit/planb64 lookup example.idx examples/trace.txt scalar > /tmp/o1.txt; echo "scalar rc=$?"; ./submit/planb64 lookup example.idx examples/trace.txt batch 3 > /tmp/o2.txt; echo "batch3 rc=$?"; ./submit/planb64 lookup example.idx examples/trace.txt batch 003 > /tmp/o3.txt; echo "batch003 rc=$?"; cmp /tmp/o1.txt examples/expected.txt && echo "OUT MATCH"; cmp /tmp/o1.txt /tmp/o2.txt && cmp /tmp/o1.txt /tmp/o3.txt && echo "MODES AGREE"; cat example.idx
